messages:
vikram: quick smoke run for new-llama-q8 onboard. compared h100/a100 across us-east / us-west / eu-west with current edge routing. sharing rough numbers and odd p95 skew in eu-west.
perf-bot: perf job 1987654321 finished (samples=1200, warmup=200) :white_check_mark:
sara: paste of aggregated latencies (ms) from the run:
```
region,gpu,p50,p95,throughput(req/s),cache_hit
us-east,h100,48,210,350,0.94
us-west,a100,62,230,300,0.91
eu-west,h100,55,490,310,0.82
```
joel: eu-west p95 ~490ms is surprising given similar p50. looks like tail-only issue, maybe extra hop or proxy. which edge POP did eu-west route through?
maggie: routing trace shows eu-west routed via edge-proxy-2 (lhr) -> backend. us-east is direct-pop. ruemetrics show cache_miss_rate eu-west 18% vs us-east 6%.
vikram: interesting — cache_miss blowup would explain tokens regen on context loads. small sketch of hit rates captured by perf job: `hits:us-east=94, us-west=91, eu-west=82`
sara: quality quick-check on eval prompts after q8 quant: macro-EM drop 0.16% overall but failures cluster on long-context QA. tails show hallucination cases coincident with high-latency traces.
joel: kernel note: aten-kernel-v2 was used for h100 in this run. there's a newer fused-attn path (aten-kernel-v3) that reduces KV-copy latency; could shave some tail. also check prefix cache TTL config — eu POP has 60s vs 10s elsewhere.
maggie: hypothesis: combined effect of longer TTL + lower cache hit => more cold KV fetches causing high p95 in eu-west. also edge-proxy-2 had a small backlog during test window.
vikram: plan: 1) run canary by overriding eu-west routing to direct-pop for 1h, 2) rerun same workload with kernel-v3 on h100, 3) short eval to monitor quality regressions under q8.
joel: i'll deploy route-override canary (route=direct-eu) at 1987654340 and spin kernel-v3 variant in parallel.
sara: I'll prepare eval prompts targeting long-context QA and compare logits/topk diffs. small script I ran earlier: ```python
# quick compare
for r in regions:
  run_eval(model='llama-q8', region=r, samples=200)
```
maggie: acked. will watch infra metrics (proxy queue, cache hit) and post snapshots. if tail improves with direct-pop then routing change + TTL tuning is low-risk mitigation.
perf-bot: canary route-override started at 1987654340 (canary-id=canary-99). monitoring enabled.
vikram: thanks team — let's reconvene after 1h snapshot. if eu-west p95 drops <250ms with direct-pop we can do short TTL rollback and kernel rollout.
